title: PZA/1
description: The one source of the PZAgent protocol PZA/1 (Plan 22 spec section 4); tools/pza_schema.py generates the Lua header, the Python module and the LLM tool descriptions from it. A definition whose x-encoding is positional describes the decoded object; on the wire its values travel as a JSON array in x-order, a kind's array opening with the kind string. A group's fields are only appended at the end of its x-order (PZA/1.1, PZAgent 1.1: me and cost; PZA/1.2, PZAgent 1.2: me's hour and the square record's edges; PZA/1.3, PZAgent 1.3: the death event; PZA/1.4, PZAgent 1.4: me's attackers, hitReaction and dragDown and the square record's hopN and hopW, ruling P24-C; PZAgent 1.4.1: the item use container, appended to its enum, and water read only for drinkable water, ruling P24-F; PZA/1.5, PZAgent 1.5: the actions aim, climb, bandage, rip, wash and fill, the square record's water, me's aiming and the part record's bleeding, bleedingTime, bandaged, bandageLife, bandageDirty, deep and infected, ruling P24-G; PZA/1.5.1, PZAgent 1.5.1: the item_changed event and the reason in bag, appended to their enums, Plan 24 Task 9 fix 1; PZA/1.5.3, PZAgent 1.5.3: bandage's keepMoving, its result's walking and the reasons leg part, stopped and aiming, appended to their enum, Plan 24 Task 9 fix 5, ruling P24-R; PZA/1.5.4, PZAgent 1.5.4: me's forceAim and the aim result's heldFrames and ticks, Plan 24 Task 9 fix 6, ruling P24-T; PZAgent 1.5.5: bandage's keepMoving description only, Plan 24 Task 9 fix 7; PZAgent 1.5.6: the me.forceAim and water.infinite descriptions only, Plan 24 Task 9 fix 8; PZA/1.6, PZAgent 1.6: the item use clothing and the loot filter clothing, appended to their enums, item_added's and item_changed's clothing record, me's worn, the door event's locked, the portal's locked read fail-closed, and the actions wear and window with the reason not a window, Plan 24 Task 9 fix 9, review-t18 ruling 5), so a reader tolerates appended fields: a group or record array from its x-prior arity up to its x-order decodes with the trailing fields null.

actionType.description: A skill type a cmd line names. There is no look action (PZA/1.5, Plan 24 Task 6b, docs/superpowers/specs/2026-10-29-plan-24-jar-reads-2.md section 6): the frames list every zombie the client's cell holds within the sense radius whatever the facing, and turning changes only what the client draws and spots.

action.description: The current timed action, null when none.

cost.description: The mod's own cost on the client.

pace.description: The measured pace in tiles a second.

running.description: Whether the running flag is set.

sprinting.description: Whether the sprinting flag is set.

forceRun.description: The force-run flag read after the frame.

forceSprint.description: The force-sprint flag read after the frame.

zombiesSeen.description: The cell's zombie list size, the frame's one walk.

zombiesListed.description: The zombies the frame lists, those alive within the sense radius.

hour.description: The game's hour of day, 0 to 24, as a number.

attackers.description: The zombies attacking the player as the drag-down counts them (PZA/1.4, P24-C): getSurroundingAttackingZombies(), the standing zombies on the player's square and its eight neighbours that target the player within 0.9 tiles in an attack or lunge state; the drag-down kills at three (two at sandbox Strength 1).

hitReaction.description: The player's hit reaction, getHitReaction(), '' when none (PZA/1.4, P24-C): set by every zombie attack that reaches the damage roll, a defended one included; no swing starts while it is set.

dragDown.description: Whether the drag-down death is marked on the player, isDeathDragDown() (PZA/1.4, P24-C).

aiming.description: Whether the player is aiming, isAiming() (PZA/1.5, P24-G): the combat stance an aim holds, or a swing's own while its animation plays; a hit reaction clears it for the reaction's length, a run or a sprint for good.

forceAim.description: The force-aim flag read after the frame, isForceAim() (PZA/1.5.4, P24-T): re-asserted every frame while the stance is held (the game clears it every frame while its toggle-to-aim option is off), so true when the flag survived the frame (not cleared by a run key or a release), while aiming shows whether the update used it; null in logs written before PZA/1.5.4.

worn.description: PZA/1.6 (Plan 24 Task 9 fix 9, review-t18 ruling 5): the body locations the worn clothing covers, each with the bite and scratch defence of the Clothing items worn there summed (getWornItems(), a bag left out), in the order the game lists them; null on every frame whose list equals the last one carried, so a reader keeps the last list it saw (the first frame carries it, [] when nothing is worn), and in logs written before PZA/1.6. Read after an item or damage event and every tenth frame otherwise. A zombie's scratch rolls under the scratch defence summed over the worn items covering the hit part, a bite under the bite defence (capped at 100): compare a garment's item record with the entry at its loc.

maxSenseMs.description: The worst events and frame read since the last frame, in ms.

part.description: One body part below full health, bandaged or bleeding.

bleeding.description: Whether the part bleeds, bleeding() (PZA/1.5, P24-G); a bandage clears the flag.

bleedingTime.description: The part's bleeding time, getBleedingTime(): kept under a bandage, which wears it ten times faster (jar-reads-2 T6b.5).

bandaged.description: Whether the part is bandaged, bandaged().

bandageLife.description: The bandage's life, getBandageLife(); null on an unbandaged part. A dirty rag's is 0 from the start.

bandageDirty.description: Whether the bandage is dirty, isBandageDirty() (its life at 0 or less: doubles the infection odds, T6b.6); null on an unbandaged part.

deep.description: Whether the part carries a deep wound, deepWounded(); a bandage clears the flag.

infected.description: Whether the wound is infected, isInfectedWound().

dist.description: The distance from the player in tiles.

hasTarget.description: Whether the zombie has a target.

wornLoc.description: One body location the worn clothing covers (PZA/1.6, me.worn).

loc.description: The body location's registry name, the WornItem's getLocation() (base:tshirt, base:jacket, base:pants); an item record's clothing.loc names the same slot.

bite.description: The summed getBiteDefense() of the Clothing worn there (0 at condition 0).

scratch.description: The summed getScratchDefense() of the Clothing worn there (0 at condition 0).

map.description: One part of a map scan: the squares it carries by position.

tick.description: The client tick the line was written on.

wallMs.description: The client's wall clock in milliseconds.

mode.description: A full scan or a delta of changed squares.

scanId.description: The scan this part belongs to.

missing.description: The Java member names the scan could not read on this part.

solidTrans.description: Whether the square blocks movement but not sight.

door.description: The square's door, null when none.

window.description: The square's window, null when none.

floor.description: The full types of the items on the floor.

blockN.description: Whether a step from this square to its north neighbour is blocked: a collide flag with no window, a closed or barricaded door, an intact closed or barricaded window, or a stair top (isBlockedTo).

blockW.description: Whether a step from this square to its west neighbour is blocked: a collide flag with no window, a closed or barricaded door, an intact closed or barricaded window, or a stair top (isBlockedTo).

edgeN.description: Whether a wall, door or window stands on the north edge, open or closed (isSomethingTo).

edgeW.description: Whether a wall, door or window stands on the west edge, open or closed (isSomethingTo).

hopN.description: Whether the square's own north edge is hoppable, has(IsoFlagType.HoppableN) (PZA/1.4, P24-C): a low fence the path follower climbs at a walk though isBlockedTo reads the edge blocked; false beside a solid wall on the same edge.

hopW.description: Whether the square's own west edge is hoppable, has(IsoFlagType.HoppableW) (PZA/1.4, P24-C): a low fence the path follower climbs at a walk though isBlockedTo reads the edge blocked; false beside a solid wall on the same edge.

water.description: The square's water source, null when none (PZA/1.5, P24-G): its first object whose hasWater() holds (a sink, a toilet, a bath, a well, a rain collector, a river, a puddle).

A water source on a square (jar-reads-2 section 7, T6b.10): a sink or a toilet in a room gives clean Water, infinite until the water shut-off and then its reserve of 20; a river or a puddle gives TaintedWater.

amount.description: The water it holds, getFluidAmount(): 10000 for an infinite source.

tainted.description: Whether its water is tainted, isTaintedWater() (a fill takes TaintedWater, a poison until boiled).

infinite.description: Whether it never runs dry (piped before the shut-off, a river): getFluidCapacity() at 10000, which it answers when the private isWaterInfinite() holds (PZA/1.5.4; null in logs written before it, where isWaterInfinite was named missing).

locked.description: Whether it is locked (PZA/1.6, fail-closed): any of isLocked(), isLockedByKey() or a thumpable's isLockedByPadlock() for a door, isLocked() or isPermaLocked() for a window, reading true, and true when none of them can be read. A locked door of a building refuses a player outside who holds no key and opens for one inside (it unlocks); a locked window struggles from outside and may lock for good, a perma-locked one never opens. Before PZA/1.6 isLocked() alone, false when unreadable.

n.description: The number of items in it.

items.description: The full types of the items in it.

clothing.description: A Clothing item's protection (PZA/1.6, Plan 24 Task 9 fix 9, review-t18 ruling 5; jar-reads-2 section 10), keyed: each field absent when its member cannot be read. A zombie's scratch or laceration rolls Rand.Next(100) under the scratch defence summed over the worn items covering the hit part without a hole there, a bite under the bite defence, capped at 100; me.worn carries the worn sums by loc.

loc.description: The body location it is worn at, getBodyLocation()'s registry name (base:tshirt): wearing it replaces the item worn there.

bite.description: Its bite defence, getBiteDefense(): 0 at condition 0.

scratch.description: Its scratch defence, getScratchDefense(), against scratches and lacerations: 0 at condition 0.

bullet.description: Its bullet defence, getBulletDefense(): 0 at condition 0.

holes.description: Its holes, getHolesNumber(): a part under a hole takes no defence from it.

event.description: One engine event, under the seq, tick and wallMs envelope every line carries; the per-kind fields sit flat beside event and gameMin.

seq.description: The envelope: the line's sequence number.

tick.description: The envelope: the client tick the line was written on.

wallMs.description: The envelope: the client's wall clock in epoch milliseconds.

gameMin.description: The game clock in minutes when the event fired.

side.description: The side whose listener saw it.

attackStarted.description: Whether the engine started the attack.

meleeDelay.description: The melee delay after the swing.

use.description: The item's use as the engine answers it: food (isA Food with getHungerChange below 0), weapon (isA HandWeapon), water (its fluid container, at most 3 litres, no Bleach or Petrol by name, not tainted, not poisonous and not sealed (canPlayerEmpty, PZA/1.5.1: a sealed pop can is other), holds a water source (isWaterSource) or, PZA/1.5, a beverage that lowers thirst and is neither hazardous nor alcoholic: a pop, a juice, a milk), container (an empty drinking vessel that may hold water, canAddFluid(Fluid.Water): PZA/1.4.1, ruling P24-F), bandage (isCanBandage(), PZA/1.5.1: a bandage, a ripped sheet, dirty or clean, or a denim or leather strip; before PZA/1.5.1 a Bandage or Rag by full type), else other. Read once at the item's first sight; an item_changed event (PZA/1.5.1) carries the use again when an action changed it. Before PZA/1.4.1 water read any non-poisonous fluid container (a Disinfectant included) and container did not exist. Absent in logs written before Plan 23 Task 9b.

worn.description: PZA/1.5.2 (Plan 24 Task 9 fix 4): true when the item is worn, isWorn() (the jar's InventoryItem.isWorn: IsClothing() and Clothing.isWorn, the item's container's parent a character whose getWornItems() contains it); absent when it is not, and in logs written before PZA/1.5.2. Read with the use.

rip.description: PZA/1.5.2 (Plan 24 Task 9 fix 4): the fabric class the rip recipes read, by tag: cotton (hasTag(ItemTag.RIP_CLOTHING_COTTON), base:ripclothingcotton, the RipClothing recipe the rip skill runs with no tool), else denim or leather (base:ripclothingdenim, base:ripclothingleather: a recipe needing scissors or a sharp knife, which the rip skill refuses needs tool); absent for an item carrying none, and in logs written before PZA/1.5.2. Read with the use. The rip skill also refuses a worn item (worn).

clothing.description: PZA/1.6 (Plan 24 Task 9 fix 9): the item's protection when its use is clothing (its class Clothing); absent otherwise, and in logs written before PZA/1.6.

event_door.description: A door changed state, read off the map's records: a scanned square, or the watch's 6-tile ring round the player on the player's floor. The watch steps at 10 Hz over the ring, so the event can lag up to about 2.3 s standing still, one watch cycle (132 ticks) and the next frame's drain; longer while moving (the ring re-centres every step) or when the square's last delta is under 30 ticks old (held one more cycle).

open.description: Whether the door is now open.

locked.description: PZA/1.6: the portal record's locked as the map read it with the open state (fail-closed); absent in logs written before PZA/1.6.

event_lua_error.description: A Lua error the mod caught.

event_overflow.description: The link cut lines over its byte budget.

event_scan_dropped.description: A scan job the map phase dropped on a Lua raise before its last part (ruling S-32): the scan's one act line, done at its start, stays its only one, and this event says its parts stopped, so the planner scans that place again.

part.description: The part being walked when the raise came (the parts before it were sent).

parts.description: The job's parts, as its done line's queued.

reason.description: The raise's message, as a lua_error event's msg.

event_death.description: The agent's own player died (PZA/1.3, ruling P23-AO): sent once per player object, on the first events read after the client's OnPlayerDeath hook named that player or its isDead read true, whichever came first; the frames go on after it. The client's health copy is no death signal in multiplayer (it can freeze above 0 on the dead character), so a reader stops on this event.

worldAge.description: The world age in hours when the event was read.

x.description: The player's x as the event's frame read it.

y.description: The player's y as the event's frame read it.

z.description: The player's floor level as the event's frame read it.

health.description: The overall body health as the client last read it (the event's frame), not necessarily 0.

via.description: Which signal raised it: hook (OnPlayerDeath named this player) or isDead (the player's isDead read true first).

zombiesKilled.description: The game's own kill count, getZombieKills; absent when that read failed (its name then in the frame reader's missing list).

event_item_changed.description: A held item's use or fluid amount changed under an action (PZA/1.5.1, Plan 24 Task 9 fix 1): a fill, a consume, a wash or a rip ending on an item still in the main inventory marks it (PZA/1.6: a wear marks the garment and the one it replaced, each read again while marked until its use, worn or clothing record changes), and for 30 s after the end the item is read again: an event at the first read when its use (read again as item_added's) changed, and when its fluid amount, held still 1 s, differs from the last one reported (the amount when the action began, first). An item's use is otherwise read once, at its first sight; a reader takes the event's use as the item's use from then on. Absent in logs written before PZA/1.5.1.

use.description: The item's use as the engine now answers it, item_added's use read again.

fluid.description: Its fluid container's primary fluid, getPrimaryFluid():getFluidTypeString() (Water, TaintedWater, a beverage); absent when it is empty or has no fluid container.

amount.description: Its fluid container's amount in litres, getAmount(); absent when it has no fluid container.

worn.description: PZA/1.5.2 (Plan 24 Task 9 fix 4): true when the item is worn, isWorn() (the jar's InventoryItem.isWorn: IsClothing() and Clothing.isWorn, the item's container's parent a character whose getWornItems() contains it); absent when it is not, and in logs written before PZA/1.5.2. Read again with the use.

rip.description: PZA/1.5.2 (Plan 24 Task 9 fix 4): the fabric class the rip recipes read, by tag: cotton (hasTag(ItemTag.RIP_CLOTHING_COTTON), base:ripclothingcotton, the RipClothing recipe the rip skill runs with no tool), else denim or leather (base:ripclothingdenim, base:ripclothingleather: a recipe needing scissors or a sharp knife, which the rip skill refuses needs tool); absent for an item carrying none, and in logs written before PZA/1.5.2. Read again with the use. The rip skill also refuses a worn item (worn).

clothing.description: PZA/1.6 (Plan 24 Task 9 fix 9): the item's protection read again when its use is clothing (its class Clothing); absent otherwise, and in logs written before PZA/1.6.

act.description: A skill's state change, with its result and a snapshot.

seq.description: The envelope: the line's sequence number.

tick.description: The envelope: the client tick the line was written on.

wallMs.description: The envelope: the client's wall clock in epoch milliseconds.

aid.description: The skill's action id from its cmd line.

reason.description: Why it was rejected or failed, empty otherwise.

result.description: The skill's result, its fields by type.

snapshot.description: The player's state when the line was written.
The player's state when an act line was written.

nearest.description: The nearest zombie, null when none.

dist.description: The distance from the player in tiles.

d.description: The distance left to the target in tiles.

attackStarted.description: Whether the engine started the last attack.

meleeDelay.description: The melee delay after the last swing.

result_interact.description: An interact's result: moved for a loot, open for an open or close.

open.description: Whether the door or window is now open.

skipped.description: Items left for the weight cap.

itemId.description: The item now in the primary hand.

queued.description: The number of map parts queued.

hz.description: The frame rate now in force.

fatigueBefore.description: The fatigue stat when the sleep began.

fatigueAfter.description: The fatigue stat when the sleep ended.

bedType.description: The engine's bed type the player slept on.

held.description: Whether the stance still held at the end (isForceAim, else isAiming): a run or a sprint clears it.

targetDead.description: Whether the target read dead (the aim ends at once when it does); false with no target.

heldFrames.description: PZA/1.5.4 (Plan 24 Task 9 fix 6, ruling P24-T): the ticks of the leg after its first whose isAiming() read true, the stance proven live; absent in logs written before PZA/1.5.4.

ticks.description: PZA/1.5.4: the ticks of the leg counted for heldFrames (every tick after its first, a target's death tick left out).

tall.description: Whether the fence was a tall one (isTallHoppable: climbOverWall, a 1 in s failure).

wounds.description: The rise in the player's scratched and bleeding part counts over the climb, 0 for a clean one.

part.description: The index of the part bandaged.

dirty.description: Whether the item was a dirty one (its full type names Dirty: life 0, the infection odds doubled).

life.description: The bandage's life once applied, getBandageLife().

moved.description: PZA/1.5.2 (Plan 24 Task 9 fix 4): true when the item sat in a bag and the skill queued vanilla's ISInventoryTransferAction to the main inventory before its own action, as the context menu does (transferIfNeeded); absent otherwise, and in logs written before PZA/1.5.2.

walking.description: PZA/1.5.3 (Plan 24 Task 9 fix 5, ruling P24-R): true when the bandage rode beside a moving walkTo or steer (keepMoving), including one that finished standing after its leg ended done; absent otherwise, and in logs written before PZA/1.5.3.

rags.description: The new items whose full type names RippedSheets.

dirty.description: How many of them are dirty (RippedSheetsDirty).

water.description: The water units the wash needed of its source, ceil(4 + 3 x the blood level).

moved.description: PZA/1.5.2 (Plan 24 Task 9 fix 4): true when the item sat in a bag and the skill queued vanilla's ISInventoryTransferAction to the main inventory before its own action, as the context menu does (transferIfNeeded); absent otherwise, and in logs written before PZA/1.5.2.

loc.description: The body location it is worn at, its clothing record's loc.

replaced.description: The id of the item worn at that location before, which the wear took off (now unworn in the inventory); absent when none was.

moved.description: True when the garment sat in a bag and the skill moved it to the main inventory first, as the context menu does; absent otherwise.

smashed.description: Whether the skill smashed the window before the climb (smash true; a smash with no weapon in hand scratches the smasher).

opened.description: Whether the skill opened the window before the climb.

cut.description: Whether the climb wounded the player (wounds above 0): climbing through a smashed window whose glass was not removed cuts a hand or forearm 1 time in 2 (jar-reads-2 section 10; the engine's call returns at once on a client, so a cut in multiplayer is the server's to make, unread).

wounds.description: The rise in the player's scratched and bleeding part counts from the climb's queue to its end.

amount.description: The container's fluid amount after the fill, in litres.

fluid.description: The container's primary fluid, getFluidTypeString() (Water, TaintedWater).

tainted.description: Whether the container's contents read tainted, isTainted().

reply.description: The answer to a query command.

seq.description: The envelope: the line's sequence number.

tick.description: The envelope: the client tick the line was written on.

wallMs.description: The envelope: the client's wall clock in epoch milliseconds.

to.description: The seq of the command it answers.

cmd.description: The one JSON line of cmd.txt: a skill for the mod to run.

aid.description: The action id the act lines answer with.

args_walkTo.description: Walk the vanilla path to a world position at a gait.

x.description: The target world x in tiles.

y.description: The target world y in tiles.

args_steer.description: Move along a world vector for a time, without a path, at a gait.

seconds.description: How long to steer in seconds.

args_attack.description: One swing at the target: done when the swing ends; read `result.attackStarted` and the target's health in the next frame; a target out of reach is approached first within the skill's budget, else `out of reach`.

args_interact.description: Open or close the door or window on a square, or loot its containers.

maxWeight.description: A loot stops before the carried weight would pass this; 0 for no cap.

args_equip.description: Equip an inventory item in the primary hand.

args_consume.description: Eat or drink an inventory item.

args_drop.description: Drop an inventory item on the player's square.

args_stop.description: Stop the current skill and every motor flag.

args_scan.description: Queue a full map scan of the squares within a radius.

hz.description: The frame rate in frames a second.

args_sleep.description: Sleep where the player stands until the engine wakes them.

args_aim.description: Hold the combat stance for a time, facing a zombie (targetId) or a bearing, while walking along a world vector (zero to stand): the backpedal. The stance walks only and never swings by itself; an attack sent while it holds swings from it. Released at its end, by any other skill (a walk or a climb cannot run in it) and when the target dies.

vx.description: The world vector's x component (0 with vy 0 to stand).

seconds.description: How long to hold the stance in seconds.

targetId.description: The zombie's online id to face each tick; -1 to face the bearing instead.

bearing.description: The world bearing to face in degrees (0 east, 90 south), used when targetId is -1; -1 keeps the current facing.

args_climb.description: Climb the hoppable fence on a square's north or west edge at a walk (never a vault): a walk to the near side, then vanilla's climb; a tall fence fails 1 time in s.

x.description: The fence square's x (the square whose hopN or hopW reads true).

args_bandage.description: Bandage a body part with a held bandage, ripped sheet or rag (vanilla's ISApplyBandage; a bandage already on the part is taken off first). A dirty rag stops the bleeding but doubles the infection odds.

part.description: The body part index; -1 for the worst: a bleeding unbandaged part (a deep wound first, then the longest bleeding time), else a wound under a dirty bandage, else an unbandaged wound.

keepMoving.description: PZA/1.5.3 (ruling P24-R): true to bandage while the running walkTo or steer keeps moving (vanilla's ISApplyBandage stops on a walk only for a leg part, index 11 UpperLeg_L to 16 Foot_R, and on a run for every part): the leg keeps driving at a walk (a run or a sprint is held to a walk for the bandage's length, the leg's gait wanted back after; a walkTo walks straight at its target meanwhile), the bandage reports its own act lines, done with walking true or failed stopped when the engine stopped it; rejected leg part for a leg part (-1 then seeks the worst above the legs) and aiming while an aim runs; with no walkTo or steer running it bandages standing, as false does, the leg-part refusal and the above-the-legs worst applying whenever keepMoving is true, whether or not a leg runs; the leg's gait is given back as soon as the bandage leaves the vanilla queue (PZA/1.5.5); the ride has no pathing and no stuck count: ride a walkTo only on an open line, else ride a steer.

args_rip.description: Rip a held, unworn cotton garment into rags with no tool (vanilla's RipClothing craft): refused worn, needs tool (denim, leather) or not cotton.

args_wash.description: Wash a held dirty rag or bandage clean at the water source on a square (a walk next to it, then vanilla's ISWashClothing; soap optional, the water's taint untested).

args_fill.description: Fill a held drinking vessel, empty (use container) or part-filled water (use water), at the water source on a square: a walk next to it, then vanilla's ISTakeWaterAction (the server moves the fluid). A river or a puddle fills TaintedWater.

args_wear.description: Put on a held garment (an item whose use is clothing) at its body location, as vanilla's Wear does (ISWearClothing, 50 ticks; a garment in a bag is moved out first): it replaces the item worn there. Refused worn when it is worn already, busy in a hit reaction or a swing, not valid for an item that is not Clothing or has no body location.

args_window.description: Climb through the window on a square (vanilla's ISClimbThroughWindow after a walk to the near side): an open or smashed one at once, a shut one opened first (ISOpenCloseWindow: a locked one opens from inside, struggles from outside and may lock for good, then fails locked) or, with smash true, smashed when it will not open (ISSmashWindow). Rejected not a window, locked (barricaded, or perma-locked without smash) or not valid (open but the far side cannot be stood on); failed fell on a fall, failed when the climb ended on the near side.

x.description: The window square's x (the square whose window record the map reads; the window sits on its north or west edge).

smash.description: True to smash the window when it will not open (perma-locked, or still shut after the open's struggle): noise, and a cut 1 time in 2 climbing through the glass; false fails locked instead.
